scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, and value proposition correctly (REQ-1, US-1)

steps.description: Open the MirDB homepage in a browser
steps.context: Homepage must be accessible and loaded

steps.description: Check that the hero section contains product name 'MirDB', tagline about persistent key-value store, and clear value proposition
steps.context: Hero section should be immediately visible above the fold

steps.description: Check for primary CTA (Get Started) and secondary CTA (View on GitHub)
steps.context: CTAs should be prominently displayed and clickable

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains 'MirDB' as headline
Tagline mentions 'Persistent Key-Value Store' and 'Memcached Protocol'
Description mentions drop-in replacement for memcached with durable storage
Get Started button is visible and has correct styling
View on GitHub button/link is visible

scenarios.name: Key Features Section
scenarios.description: Verify features section highlights memcached compatibility, persistence, and LSM tree architecture (REQ-2, US-2)

steps.description: Navigate to the features section of the homepage
steps.context: Features section should be clearly identifiable

steps.description: Check that three primary feature cards are displayed with appropriate content
steps.context: Each feature should have a title and description

steps.description: Validate that each feature description accurately represents MirDB's capabilities
steps.context: Descriptions should match PRD specifications

test_cases.input: Check for Memcached Protocol Compatible feature
test_cases.expected: Feature card displays 'Memcached Protocol Compatible' with description about existing client compatibility
Feature card displays 'Persistent Storage' with description about data surviving restarts and SSTables

test_cases.input: Check for LSM Tree Architecture feature
test_cases.expected: Feature card displays 'LSM Tree Architecture' with description about write performance and compaction

test_cases.input: Verify features section has visual elements
test_cases.expected: Feature cards have icons or visual indicators

scenarios.name: Getting Started Section
scenarios.description: Verify Getting Started section displays installation instructions and code examples (REQ-3, US-3)

steps.description: Scroll to or click navigation to reach Getting Started section
steps.context: Section should be accessible via navigation or scrolling

steps.description: Check that installation commands are displayed
steps.context: Should include commands for installing MirDB

steps.description: Check that basic usage examples (SET, GET operations) are shown
steps.context: Code should demonstrate connecting and performing basic operations

steps.description: Ensure code blocks have proper syntax highlighting
steps.context: NFR-6: Code examples must include syntax highlighting

test_cases.expected: Installation command is displayed (e.g., cargo install or similar)
Code example showing SET command usage is present
Code example showing GET command usage is present

test_cases.input: Verify code syntax highlighting is applied
test_cases.expected: Code blocks have CSS classes or styles for syntax highlighting (e.g., Prism.js classes)

test_cases.input: Check for link to full documentation
test_cases.expected: Link to detailed documentation is present in Getting Started section

scenarios.name: Navigation and Links
scenarios.description: Verify navigation links to documentation, GitHub, and community resources work correctly (REQ-4, US-4, US-6)

steps.description: Check that header contains navigation links to main sections
steps.context: Navigation should include Features, Getting Started, Documentation, GitHub

steps.description: Click each navigation link and verify it scrolls to correct section
steps.context: Internal links should use smooth scrolling to sections

steps.description: Verify GitHub and documentation links point to correct URLs
steps.context: External links should open in appropriate context

test_cases.expected: Features navigation link exists and scrolls to features section

test_cases.input: Check navigation contains Getting Started link
test_cases.expected: Getting Started navigation link exists and scrolls to correct section
GitHub link points to valid repository URL
Documentation link is present and functional

test_cases.input: Verify external links have appropriate rel attributes
test_cases.expected: External links have rel='noopener' or 'noreferrer' for security
Footer has link to GitHub repository
Footer displays license information

steps.context: Simulate mobile device viewing experience

steps.description: Check all content is readable without horizontal scrolling
steps.context: Page should adapt to narrow viewport

steps.description: Check hamburger menu is present and functional
steps.context: Navigation should collapse to mobile-friendly format

steps.description: Check code examples are horizontally scrollable
steps.context: Code should remain readable on small screens

test_cases.expected: Page renders without horizontal scrollbar on main content
Hamburger menu icon is visible on mobile viewport
Navigation menu expands and shows all navigation links
Hero content is readable and properly sized
Feature cards stack vertically on mobile
Code blocks allow horizontal scrolling without breaking layout

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify homepage meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards (NFR-2)

steps.description: Use Lighthouse to audit accessibility score
steps.context: Score must be >= 90

steps.description: Check proper heading hierarchy and landmark regions
steps.context: HTML should use semantic elements appropriately

steps.description: Navigate entire page using only keyboard
steps.context: All interactive elements should be keyboard accessible

steps.description: Check text has sufficient contrast against backgrounds
steps.context: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text

test_cases.expected: Accessibility score is >= 90
Headings follow proper order (h1, h2, h3) without skipping levels

test_cases.input: Check for alt text on images
test_cases.expected: All images have descriptive alt attributes
All buttons, links are focusable in logical order
Visible focus indicators on all interactive elements
All text meets 4.5:1 minimum contrast ratio
Icons and buttons have appropriate ARIA labels
Page has main, nav, and footer landmark regions

scenarios.name: Performance Requirements
scenarios.description: Verify homepage loads within 3 seconds and meets performance metrics (NFR-3)

steps.description: Use Lighthouse to audit performance score
steps.context: Score must be >= 80

steps.description: Check time to interactive and first contentful paint
steps.context: Page must load within 3 seconds on standard broadband

steps.description: Verify images and assets are optimized
steps.context: Assets should be appropriately sized and compressed

test_cases.expected: Performance score is >= 80
FCP is under 2 seconds
TTI is under 3 seconds
Total page weight is reasonable for static site (< 1MB)
Images are appropriately sized and compressed
